title: Colts place rarely used transition tag on QB Jones

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Colts place rarely used transition tag on QB Jones
sources.description: The Colts place the rarely used transition tag on QB Daniel Jones, preserving their right to match any offer sheet in free agency.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Colts place transition tag on Daniel Jones
